bounded_statement: The selected result asserts an occurrence rate 'for the entire scheduled survey network', whose complete domain is stated in the same report as all 96 scheduled stations, but the computation divides 18 occurrences by only the 72 stations retained after the signal screen; the 24 screen-omitted scheduled stations are excluded from the exposure denominator, so a retained-subset computation (18/72 = 0.25) is presented as a complete-domain quantity, whereas the complete-domain computation on the visible data is 18/96 = 0.1875.
